module: Builds the tiles displayed by the vehicle selector grid. It configures a tilesModule (ui/gridSelectorUtils/tilesModule) with three "paths": allModels (all vehicles, grouped then clustered), configsForBrandSubModelOrModel and configsForModel (list of a model's configs, with subgroups). It applies filters, favorites, recents, sorting and default selection, then the first drive tutorial restrictions. It relies on tileSorting, tileGrouping and tileClustering.
notes: A config's tile notably contains key ('model/config'), name, preview, model_key, config_key, configType, showDetails, doubleClickDetails, favouriteIdx, recentIdx, sourceIcons, isAuxiliary, as well as Value, Weight, Top Speed, Power, Power/Weight, 0-60 mph and 0-100 km/h.
getTiles uses tilesInstance, created in onExtensionLoaded: calling getTiles before the extension is fully loaded would cause an error.

Display modes of favorites and recents: 'hidden', 'reducedClusters', 'completeClusters' and 'unclustered'; 'completeClusters' removes the individual configs from the special group to keep only the clusters.

'Automatic' sort: recents by ascending recentIdx, favorites by descending favouriteIdx, otherwise by Value or Years (depending on groupMode) or by name. In a model's config list, the default automatic sort is by Value.
The default selection is marked by isDefaultSelected, and forceAutoFocus for the tile requested by overrideDefaultSelectedTile (consumed after the first getTiles).
Emits the hook onVehicleSelectorGetTiles(path, modelKey, modelSubKey, brandKey, groupMode, groupName) when displaying a model's configs.
The freeroam tiles mark the configurator's current selection (cornerIcon = 'car') via freeroam_freeroamConfigurator.

getTiles.desc: Returns the tile groups for a selector path (allModels, configsForModel, configsForBrandSubModelOrModel), then applies any restrictions from gameplay_discover_firstDrive_vehicleSelectorRestriction and freeroamTutorial_vehicleSelectorRestriction.

path.desc: Path {keys = {...}}; keys[1] is the path type.

pathChanged.desc: Indicates that the path has changed (passed to tilesModule).

configToTile.desc: Converts a vehicle config into a grid tile.

fullName.desc: true to use the full name (Name) rather than the Configuration.

clusterItems.desc: Groups configs into clusters according to the clusterMode of the display options (delegates to tileClustering.clusterItems).

overrideDefaultSelectedTile.desc: Sets the tile to select and focus by default on the next getTiles (the model_key and config_key or key fields identify the config).

emptyProfiler.desc: Creates a fake profiler with no effect (start, add, finish).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: creates the tilesModule instance with the path handlers, the sorting, grouping and clustering modules, and the data and filtering functions of ui_vehicleSelector_general.
